(Currently Amended) Claim 281: A tool comprising: a lamination of at least two layers; a first adhesive layer and a second adhesive layer being bonded to opposite sides of a medial section of the tool; and an additional adhesive layer, wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are aligned with each other.

(Currently Amended) Claim 282: The tool of claim 281 wherein the medial section comprises a metal.

(Currently Amended) Claim 283: The tool of claim 282 wherein the metal is a honeycomb structure.

(Currently Amended) Claim 284: The tool of claim 281 wherein the medial section is a composite material.

(Currently Amended) Claim 285: The tool of claim 281 further comprising a weld ring at least partially interposed between a perimeter of the first and second layers.

(Currently Amended) Claim 286: The tool of claim 285 wherein the weld ring is bonded to the medial section.

(Currently Amended) Claim 287: The tool of claim 281 further comprising a plurality of cutting segments bonded to an outer perimeter of the first and second layers.

(Currently Amended) Claim 288: The tool of claim 281 wherein the weld ring is continuous.

(Currently Amended) Claim 290: The tool of claim 285 further comprising an inner ring wherein the medial section is coupled on an inner perimeter to the inner ring.

(Currently Amended) Claim 291: The tool of claim 290 wherein the inner ring includes a central opening.

(Currently Amended) Claim 293: The tool of claim 281 further comprising a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers and wherein the plurality of cutting segments are located on an outer periphery of the weld ring.

(Currently Amended) Claim 294: The tool of claim 293 wherein the weld ring is continuous.
